description:
### PixelBoard Patches (v1.3.6)

* **Advanced Settings Crash Resolution**: Restored all extension Android resource R classes (R, R$string, R$color, R$drawable) in extension DEX runtime, preventing NoClassDefFoundError crashes when launching Advanced Settings
* **Candidate Strip Reordering**: Added candidate suggestions reordering for the suggestion strip (reorderCandidatesForStrip)
* **Safe Haptic Feedback Hook**: Hardened haptic feedback invocation (performHapticFeedback) across devices and themes
* **Screen Rotation Grace Period for Rambler Dictation**: Maintains continuous voice typing and audio recording across screen orientation changes by introducing a 1.5s grace period during display rotation, preventing voice sessions from aborting (#146, PR #165 by Francisco Valentim Castilho)
* **Preserve Speech Diff for Mid-Sentence Voice Edits**: Retains speech diffs for voice replacements and mid-sentence voice commands (such as "replace X with Y"), word edits in respoken phrases, and mid-sentence cursor placements without overwriting surrounding compositions (#167)
* **Strict Language Enforcement & Anti-Drift**: Disabled proactive parallel ASR and seamless fallback in Rambler stock policy to prevent voice dictation from unintentionally switching languages or drifting to similar locales (e.g. Czech -> Slovak) (#154)
* **Eliminate Text Duplication on Dictation Start**: Fixed an issue where starting dictation in an editor containing pre-existing text or recently pasted clipboard items would duplicate text at the cursor (#166)
* **Native Split Readiness Gate Check for Gboard 18.6.3**: Added native library readiness gate check for split APK components on Gboard 18.6.3 (`Lsmi;`, `Locf;`) ensuring seamless JNI loading on fused and split APKs (#168)
* **AI Writing Tools Connectivity Fix**: Repaired request timeout and prompt template evaluation in GboardAiWritingToolsRuntime, eliminating "cannot connect to server" errors and restoring reliable Rephrase, Proofreading, and Tone adjustments via Google's Gboard server backend
* **Direct Boot & Secure Storage Safety**: Added user unlock state checks (UserManager.isUserUnlocked) ensuring crash-free preference initialization during direct boot before initial unlock
* **Morphe Manager Patch Bundle DEX Packaging**: Included classes.dex directly in the root of the .mpp patch bundle via :patches:buildAndroid so Morphe Manager detects and loads all 4 patches out-of-the-box
* **Android 10+ (API 29) Minimum SDK Compatibility**: Clamped minSdkVersion in package manifest to API 29, enabling full installation and coexistence on Android 10 and Android 11 devices without package parser errors
* **Refined Softkey Label Sanitizer**: Cleaned up the symbol key label patch to focus strictly on AutoCenterScaleTextView keycap rendering, removing unnecessary input connection hooks to prevent text insertion side-effects
* **Enhanced Clipboard Retention & 100-Item Cap**: Unpinned clips kept for 24 hours by default, history cap raised from 5 to 100 recent clips, customizable slider (1h, 24h, 7d, 30d, Never) and honest duration strings across 83 locales (#129)
* **Pre-Activated Google Sans Flex & Undo Actions**: Google Sans Flex typography and Undo action key are pre-enabled and enforced by default
* **In-App Updates**: Dedicated PixelBoard updates section directly in Gboard settings with GitHub release checks, formatted changelogs, and direct APK download
* **Standalone Coexistence**: Side-by-side installation with stock Gboard

Supports Gboard v18.6.3 (Release), v18.5.3 (Release), v18.4.1 (Release), and v18.3.1 (Release / Beta).
